story.title: Adobe Opens New Noida Office With AI Innovation Focus as India Deepens Its Role in Global R&D
story.summary: Adobe has expanded its India footprint with a new office in Noida, explicitly positioned as a centre for advancing AI-driven innovation and marking what the company calls an important milestone in driving global product development from India. The opening reflects a broader trend of multinational technology firms deepening their India R&D and AI engineering presence as Indian talent pools grow. Adobe has significant India operations and the new facility is expected to support work on AI-powered creative and document tools.
